parameters.query: SELECT a.id AS app_id, a.resume_id, j.id AS job_id, j.title, j.company_name, j.url, coalesce(j.description,'') AS description, left(res.raw_text, 1500) AS resume_snippet FROM app.applications a JOIN app.jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id JOIN app.resumes res ON res.id = a.resume_id WHERE a.status = 'ready' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.outreach o WHERE o.application_id = a.id) ORDER BY a.created_at ASC LIMIT 5;
